name: Critical Integrity
summary: Critical Integrity is a Holy-Trinity, tab-targeting ARPG rogue-lite dungeon crawler for 1–4 players. You've been summoned by the omnipotent System to cleanse the corruption spreading through a crumbling multiverse. Battle through dungeons drawn from every corner of that multiverse, solo or in co-op, growing your strength through powerful loot and permanent class rank-ups. Defeat monsters to level up and choose new abilities for your delve into ever-higher corruption. And should you perish, fear not: the System pulls you back to Haven, your bastion of safety in the crumbling universe, where merchants and crafters help you prepare for the next dive. Your gear, class ranks, and corruption level unlocks carry over every run, so you always come back stronger. Rescue the citizens of the multiverse and aid The System!
